QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Jay the Warlock
QuestInfo.0: The corrupted Empress and her Cygnus Knights #rbrought Henesys to ruin#k. Maybe there's been some kind of misunderstanding. Listen to what the townspeople have to say. Start with #bJay#k.
QuestInfo.1: Jay says the Black Mage's magic changed the monsters around Henesys, and asks you to bring #b40 Mutant Snail Shells#k for research.
QuestInfo.2: Jay chose the path of a warlock to grow stronger, saying that he was weak and couldn't protect his parents or the town.

no.0: What could be more important than fighting back?

item.0: There's no time to waste. Please get me 40 Mutant Snail Shells.
